description: Admin tool. Create a Gameye API token and write it to a file; the token value is never returned. outputPath must be an absolute path outside any git working tree; an existing file is refused unless overwrite=true, and symlinks are always refused. The file is created with 0600 permissions. expires_after defaults to 24h. Requested scopes must be a subset of this server's token scopes (webhook:github is the one exception). Needs the token:write scope. Pass dryRun=true to preview the request.

dryRun.description: Check outputPath and return the request that would be sent; create nothing

expires_after.description: Lifetime such as '1h' or '2h30m' (units m and h). Defaults to 24h

outputPath.description: Absolute path of the file to write the token to

overwrite.description: Replace an existing regular file at outputPath

scopes.description: Scopes for the new token, e.g. ['session:read']

name: gameye_create_token
title: Create API token
